'''''Still Life - Kite Plant''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] rumored to have been created by the legendary [[Artist/Legends|artist]] known as [[Bahzel]]. Copies of the work were available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was in a still life that depicted a [[Color/Legends|beige]] [[kite plant]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], on an off-white background.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Still Life - Kite Plant'' appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games#Massive multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment. Normally unavailable to players as it was meant to be used only as decoration in developer-created buildings, a glitch from the early days of the game allowed players to pick up any item their characters could examine from non-player character owned buildings. The painting could be used as decoration in the player character's home if one has obtained a copy.<ref name="SWG" />
